text:
ana-ml: Heads-up: we're evaluating 'cormorant-7b' for embeddings and a quantized throughput study. Repo license is "NonCommercial Research 1.2" and it has an explicit clause: no redistribution of weights or derivatives and embeddings allowed only for non-commercial research. Can we proceed in Dedicated or run multi-tenant evals?

 tom-prod: If embeddings are flagged as non-commercial, we can't expose them via Hosted paid endpoints. Dedicated reserved pools used by paying customers would be commercial.

 leah-legal: Correct. Summary:
- Hosting inference for paying customers = commercial -> disallowed.
- Quantized artifacts = derivative weights -> cannot redistribute or persist in customer-accessible storage.
- Embeddings: license ties them to non-commercial research; do not offer in any paid product or public demo without permission.

 omar-ops: Practically, we can do performance runs on our isolated "research" project. Suggest ephemeral VMs/GPU nodes with no backups and no object-store writes. CI-bot can tag logs.

 ana-ml: Plan then: run in research infra, do in-memory quantize-and-run, delete any temp checkpoints, and do embeddings only for internal evals. I'll open ticket ML-2028 to contact upstream for commercial terms.

 leah-legal: Add: capture the exact attribution text in reports and keep correspondence if upstream replies. If they agree to commercial terms, legal will review the amend.

 ci-bot: Created ticket ML-2028 and added label "research-only" :white_check_mark:

 tom-prod: Thanks. We'll block routes in the model registry so it can't be accidentally deployed to prod routes.

 ana-ml: Copy. Will post results and any upstream reply in ML-2028.
